pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions when floating unrealized loss exceeds 0.5 ATR or when price action penetrates local structural support/resistance.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe momentum convergence confirmation via RSI/MACD histogram and ATR volatility filter before execution; absolute ban on entering within 15 minutes of tier-1 macro news wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated partial profit-taking at +$5.00 with a trailing stop locking in breakeven, permitting the remainder to runner up to +$15.00-$30.00.
